notablePrerequisites:
Ebonblade Reaper does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Declare Ebonblade Reaper as an attacker.
Ebonblade Reaper's first ability triggers, causing you to lose half your life total, rounded up.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Ebonblade Reaper.
Ebonblade Reaper's second ability triggers, causing the defending opponent to lose their entire life total due to Bloodletter of Aclazotz.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
